meta.title: OECD DAC2A: ODA to Lebanon by donor and year
meta.license_note: OECD terms of use apply CC BY 4.0 to most OECD data with attribution; the dataflow page was not opened for a dataset-specific statement, so treat as stated by OECD terms, not re-verified.
meta.years: 1960 to 2024; 2024 is preliminary. Years with no value are omitted.
meta.unit: US dollars, millions. net_oda_usd_m is measure 206 (ODA, net disbursements; equals measure 250 in 2023 for the donors checked). oda_grants_usd_m is 201, oda_loans_net_usd_m 218, humanitarian_aid_usd_m 216, gross_oda_usd_m 240. net_oda_constant_2024_usd_m is measure 206 at constant 2024 prices.
meta.kinds: aggregate rows (Official donors, DAC countries, DAC EU countries, Non-DAC countries, UN, World Bank, EU Institutions groups, Private Donors) contain their members: never add an aggregate to its members. Multilateral rows are what the organisation disbursed itself, not what DAC members gave it.
meta.check: Official donors (ALLD) net ODA 2023 = 1,747.103 million, equal to the World Bank WDI DT.ODA.ODAT.CD 2023 value of 1,747,103,271 seen in the scout report.
meta.double_counting: ODA overlaps with FTS humanitarian funding (the same dollars can appear in both) and with IATI. Never sum OECD ODA, FTS or World Bank commitments.
meta.not_included: Sector and channel detail (CRS) was not retrieved: DF_CRS key syntax failed in the scout and was not retried here.
